rules: Derive every displayed number from series, comparisons, or headline.
Display scientific_status.disclosure beside any quantitative claim.
Describe point bands as observed minima and maxima, never confidence intervals.
Never use distribution clearance to upgrade the experiment's scientific tier.

design.statistical_unit: paired held-out seed within a predeclared SNR cell

headline.accessible_summary: Across seven predeclared SNR cells, the observed learned-versus-uncompensated BER change ranged from 16.18% to 98.87%; the largest absolute relative gap between the learned receiver and calibrated diagnostic reference was 0.25%.
headline.text: At 10 dB, the learned receiver reduced mean pre-decoder BER by 98.87% relative to uncompensated QPSK.

video_overlay.title: Learned QPSK I/Q calibration receiver — complete Noema workflow

scientific_status.disclosure: Completed experimental demonstration—not a publication-ready canonical benchmark.
limitations: The committed CSV is a deterministic projection of the local completed result, not a replacement for its full run-evidence snapshot.
Three paired held-out seeds support a demonstration comparison but are not a universal publication-strength sample size.
scientific_status.reference_role: The calibrated I/Q oracle is a diagnostic reference with calibration knowledge, not a deployable competitor using the same information.
warnings: This completed experimental demonstration is not yet a publication-ready canonical benchmark.
